verdict.rationale: Viam documents a built-in data manager that captures component output on the machine and syncs it to the cloud. Data queues locally during network outages and in low-bandwidth environments, then syncs when connectivity returns, with restarts and storage constraints handled automatically. Captured sensor data and telemetry can then be queried in the cloud. missing for 10: documentation of configurable bandwidth-aware sync policies (capture frequency, sync intervals, filtering or prioritization), in-depth data-manager configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
